guidance.heading: 2026 ANNUAL GUIDANCE
section: NOG is raising its annual production guidance for the year to reflect outperformance in the third quarter. The Company is maintaining its Capital Expenditures budget guidance but expects Cap Ex to trend toward the high-end of the range based on current activity levels. Ranges for operating costs, production taxes and cash G&A have been adjusted to reflect costs incurred year to date. Ranges for oil differentials and gas realizations have been adjusted for year to date actuals and expectations for the fourth quarter.
